description: The JobCrawls employers listing (the /employers page): employers with open jobs, filtered by text, city, the role they hire, remote work, growing hiring and a pay floor, sorted by hiring volume, Employer Score letter, advertised pay or name. Each row gives the Employer Score as a letter (A best), open jobs, hiring trend, median advertised monthly pay, remote and hybrid shares, top roles and the profile link. Staffing and consulting agencies are left out unless asked for. Grades are letters, not numbers. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

agencies.description: Staffing and consulting agencies: left out (default), mixed in, or listed alone.

city.description: The employer's registered city, for example "Tampere".

growing.description: Only employers whose hiring trend is growing.

industry.description: An industry name in English, exactly as the listing shows it (for example "Software").

limit.description: Rows to return from the page.

locale.description: Language of the result and of the linked jobcrawls.com pages. Defaults to English.

minMonthlyPay.description: Only employers whose median advertised monthly pay low end is at least this many euros.

query.description: Text matched against company name, industry and hired roles.

remote.description: Only employers where at least half of the open ads are remote or hybrid.

role.description: A role the employer hires for, for example "nurse".

sort.description: Order of the results. Without it, hiring volume, or text relevance when a query is given.

name: find_employers

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.

title: Find and rank employers
